topics.threshold_source: SOURCE-SUPPORTED: docs/NATIVE_PI5_BASELINE_ARCHITECTURE.md N3 requires relevant calibration/TF topics; n3_topics.json includes /tf_static

pairing.threshold_source: PROPOSED: exact header-stamp pairing with at most 1% unmatched images

storage.threshold_source: PROPOSED: 16.6 MB/s comparison ceiling derived from SOURCE-SUPPORTED achieved throughput in experiments/2026-10-14-SESSION_FACTS_ADDENDUM.md section 3 (1.66 GB / 100 s), below 18.4 MB/s required demand. This is not a sustained-write qualification or a measurement of the current destination. PROPOSED: min_duration_s=1. UNTESTED ON HARDWARE: retained historical value, NOT destination qualification. Before recording, max_write_rate_bps must be set in a reviewed destination-specific config from the qualified destination measured sustained fsync write rate; 18.4 MB/s demand exceeds historical 16.6 MB/s. Qualification target >=27.6 MB/s per docs/D435I_CALIBRATION_PLAN.md:160; docs/STORAGE_QUALIFICATION_DRAFT.md requires owner review.

replay.threshold_source: PROPOSED: replay rate within 10% and at least 99% of recorded samples; PROPOSED: playback factor, discovery delay, drain interval, spin interval and subscriber queue depths are diagnostic operating settings

record.threshold_source: PROPOSED: bounded diagnostic window and command timeouts for Pi operation; PROPOSED: at least 80% of requested wall interval covered by bag receive-time span, allowing recorder startup/shutdown overhead; early self-exit requires 95% elapsed interval

validation.threshold_source: PROPOSED: no reversed/repeated dynamic header stamps, receive-time reversals, malformed CDR headers or gaps over the configured nominal-period multiple
